reasoning: Gregory Canyon is a well-known canyon west of Boulder along the South Platte River in Boulder County, Colorado. The head of Gregory Canyon (its westernmost end) is located near the Eldorado Springs area where the canyon meets the South Platte valley. North-facing slopes at this location would be on the southern walls of the canyon as it opens toward the valley floor. The overhanging granite rocks are characteristic of this area, which sits within and adjacent to the Boulder Creek batholith and surrounding granitic formations of the Front Range. The estimated coordinates place this locality in Boulder County, Colorado, west of Boulder city limits, at approximately 40.13°N latitude and 105.38°W longitude.
